title: Add P0 integration and control add-in runtime guidance
summary: Adds guidance and code samples for linking API parts on SystemId with Multiplicity set, webhook eligibility and validationToken renewal, credentialed AJAX loading of packaged control add-in resources, and throttling AL calls and payload size from control add-ins. The web-services and UI review skills were extended to match.
key_points: Guidance and AL samples for linking API parts on SystemId and setting Multiplicity
Webhook eligibility and validationToken renewal patterns with AL and JS samples
Control add-in AJAX requests for packaged resources need withCredentials
Control add-in calls to AL should be serialized and kept within a byte limit
Web-services and UI review skills gained new tokens, worklist cues and detection boundaries
quote: add atomic guidance and focused samples for SystemId API-part links/multiplicity and webhook eligibility/lifecycle handshakes
